GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.93 (1 Dec 45) GC-P
(SCAPIN - 375)
1 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Operation of Japanese Weather Service.
You are authorized to resume operations of the civil meteorological station located on Nii Shima, Latitude 34 degrees 23 North Longitude 139' degrees 17' East. The above station is to report hourly and is assigned International Station Index No.263.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
